params.caption: 🎮 "GTA Flu" spreads as GTA 6 launches worldwide With GTA 6 rolling out globally, businesses are bracing for a wave of so-called "GTA flu" as staff call in sick to play, and reports suggest thousands will skip school or work, with a measurable hit to economies. KFC Australia is even in on the joke, staging a fake funeral for the "definitely real" Ann Alibi so fans have an excuse to take the day off. 🕒 Nov 18, 2026 · 14:12 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: IGN · IGN 👥 @RockstarGames 🤒 React if you're "sick" today · 💬 Did you take the day off for GTA 6? #GTA6 #RockstarGames #GTAFlu #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
